title: Knowledge from outside: a summary in our own words with its citation, link and licence, refused when it copies its source
plan: Refuse a finding without citation, link and licence.
Refuse a summary sharing a run of 30 words with its source.
Keep it as from_the_literature in the teachers kind.

decisions.decision: An outside finding is untrusted until a DCLab campaign tests it.
The id is a hash of the citation and the summary.

findings.defect: The first id used hash(), randomised per process.
findings.scenario: The same finding got a new id each run.

findings.defect: copies() could not refuse a short copy, and was skipped without a source text.
findings.scenario: A 25-word sentence copied word for word passed.
findings.cause: Only runs of 30 words were checked.
findings.fix: Source text required; any 12-word run or over 30% of 8-word runs refused.

findings.defect: Outside findings could not be accepted or tested, and were filed as teacher answers.
findings.scenario: knowledge() never read them; they failed the teacher_answer rule.
findings.fix: Kept as knowledge/external in the other kind, read by knowledge(); tested() links a campaign or flags a counterexample.

outcome: Outside findings are kept with their source, never copied.
lessons: Write fixtures from the code that writes the records (a stage record copied from the engine), never from memory: invented shapes made every test pass while every real build was judged wrong.
risks: Running the research agent that finds them needs the owner's yes and a cap.
